decisive_items: Positive for CD2, cytoplasmic CD3, CD30, perforin, TIA-1
Negative for CD4, CD5, CD7, CD8, TCR-gamma, ALK-1
Near-total effacement of marrow by necrotic, high-grade tumor
response.rationale: Bone marrow necrosis with high-grade tumor and cytotoxic T-cell immunophenotype (CD2+, cCD3+, CD30+, perforin+, TIA-1+, ALK-1-) strongly indicates ALCL, T-cell type. R1 is broader PTCL; R10C is the specific subtype.

rejected.why: Sterile cultures and lack of focal infection; fever/CRP are nonspecific.
No lymphadenopathy or characteristic histology; imaging findings are nonspecific.
Marrow effacement by tumor contradicts aplastic anemia.
Less specific than R10C; R10C adds subtype-defining immunophenotype.
Too broad; lacks T-cell lineage specification.
Anti-myositis antibodies negative and muscle biopsy nonspecific; marrow tumor is key.
Marrow tumor and immunophenotype not MDS.
HLH is secondary; underlying lymphoma is primary diagnosis.
PTCL is correct but less precise than ALCL given CD30+ and ALK-1-.
Lymphoma-associated HLH is a complication; primary diagnosis is T-cell lymphoma.
